title: Apprenticeship & Earn-and-Learn Matcher
description: Find DOL RAPIDS Registered Apprenticeship Programs by occupation. Models wage progression (50–90% of journeyworker wage), cumulative earnings during program, opportunity cost vs. current income, and post-completion wage gain. Covers 30 DOL RAPIDS-registered occupations across construction, healthcare, IT, manufacturing, energy & utilities, and transportation & logistics.
data_vintage: DOL RAPIDS Program Year 2023 · BLS OEWS May 2023

occupation.description: Occupation name from the 30-entry RAPIDS catalog

state_of_interest.description: US state for program search (informational; occupation is the primary axis)

current_annual_income.description: User's current annual income in USD for opportunity cost comparison

mcp_tool_definition.name: match_apprenticeship_program
mcp_tool_definition.description: Given an occupation and optionally a state and current income, returns DOL RAPIDS registered apprenticeship program data including wage progression model, cumulative earnings during program, opportunity cost analysis, and AP2 mandate for downstream handoff to AL-02 or AL-07.

occupation.description: One of the 30 supported RAPIDS occupations (e.g., 'Electrician', 'Cybersecurity Analyst')

state_of_interest.description: US state abbreviation or full name

current_annual_income.description: Current annual income in USD for opportunity cost calculation

regulatory_citations: DOL RAPIDS Registered Apprenticeship Data, Program Year 2023
BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS), May 2023
29 CFR Part 29 — Labor Standards for the Registration of Apprenticeship Programs
WIOA Title I-B — Adult and Dislocated Worker Activities
